issue.title: store_snapshot_create_records_note_snapshot_route fails on hosts missing titlesec.sty because it skips only on absent pandoc/xelatex

task_type_fields.why_not_flake:
Deterministic, not intermittent. On apollo `kpsewhich titlesec.sty` exits 1 (titlesec is not installed in that TeX Live), and the note-snapshot print profile (`src/native/highlights_ref/note_snapshot/note.tex`, `profile.rs`) requires titlesec. The test only gates on `pandoc --version` and `xelatex --version` (tests/cli/highlights/store_gaps.rs:201-213), so it runs a real xelatex snapshot render and fails. bob-cli-d3.2 and bob-cli-d3.3 each reproduced it on their epic trees and on the clean base tree (identical failure), so the bob-cli-d3 epic did not cause it.

Fix (root cause known): gate this test like the vault-note real-render tests in tests/cli/highlights/create.rs, which call `skip_if_missing_note_profile_packages(vault)` (it reads the `latex_packages:` row from `bob highlights doctor`, which runs kpsewhich over the note profile's declared package list). Move that helper into a shared test-support module and call it from `store_snapshot_create_records_note_snapshot_route` (and any other snapshot real-render test that lacks it).

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by epic phases bob-cli-d3.2 and bob-cli-d3.3, which both hit this base-identical failure on apollo; the test's skip gate is narrower than the note profile's TeX package needs.

payload.description: Snapshot epic that introduced the titlesec-dependent note print profile

payload.entry: Shared gate d208c595 verified on athena at f00854be+predicate repair: gate unit test support::note_profile_package_skip_reports_missing_packages passes; store_snapshot_create_records_note_snapshot_route renders for real in 7.52s with packages installed (no skip, pass); kpsewhich-exit-1 shim with xelatex wrapper keeps pandoc/xelatex available and proves the skip path in 0.26s with missing-package message listing fvextra..xurl including titlesec.sty. Full cargo test --no-fail-fast passes (3759 lib + 2306 cli, 0 failed). Ready, no force.
